mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (receiver_id, sender_id, type, target_id, is_read) VALUES (#{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{targetId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.type, n.target_id AS targetId, n.is_read AS isRead, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.sender_id AS senderId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS senderName, u.avatar AS senderAvatar, p.title AS postTitle FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = n.sender_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = n.target_id WHERE n.receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
